allowed_demo_statements.statement: The CAPEX summary grid is now rendered via the shared LineItemGrid partial.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The runtime summary, validation summary, and banner context are now available on the index page.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The context wiring is a UI refactor; the underlying state is unchanged.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The Help section has been moved into a dedicated section.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The Help section is a UI refactor; the underlying instructions are unchanged.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The New Project form has been simplified.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The form simplification is a UI refactor; the required fields and validation are unchanged.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The COD is now derived from construction_start_date and construction_duration_months.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The project switcher has been simplified.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The state banner hierarchy has been polished.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The state banner is a UI refactor; the underlying state is unchanged.

allowed_demo_statements.statement: The route-render smoke and index context-contract tests are now in place.
allowed_demo_statements.required_caveat: The tests are guardrails for the UI-3 work; they do not validate the underlying state or authorize any external claim.

global_notes: UI polish is a UI refactor. UI polish does not change the financial model, does not validate the engine output, does not authorize paid pilot, does not constitute external validation.

The LineItemGrid pilot (Phase 57A) is a single-sheet pilot. It migrates only app/templates/partials/sheet_capex.html to the shared LineItemGrid partial/macro. The LineItemGrid pilot is not a full spreadsheet engine, not a replacement for the underlying financial model, and not a full UI-3 rollout.
The CAPEX summary pilot does not constitute model validation. The parity-core lock is unchanged. The engine-output golden is unchanged.
B1, B11, B19, B22 remain the primary no-go claim artifacts. B38 is a UI-focused refresh, not a replacement.
Claude review / post-51T review are separate workstreams. They are referenced only as review evidence, not external validation or certification.
